qa_log.question: Source of "Invoice Type": there are 2 possible sources — (a) the Invoice Type saved on each invoice when the billing was created (snapshot), (b) the current Invoice Type of the Billing To master. If the master is changed after the invoice is issued, (a) keeps the old type and (b) shows the new type. Also, an invoice that bundles multiple sales may be printed in the Simple layout even when the master is Detailed. Which value should be displayed, filtered and downloaded? Our proposal is (a).

4.1 says "Display the Invoice Type of the Billing To master". We understand: pull-down options = the Invoice Type values defined in the Billing To master (7 values), and the search filters by the Invoice Type of each invoice (same value as the detail column). Is this correct?
The "Download Sample" in 4.3 is blank in the document. Could you share it? Also, please confirm that only "全件ダウンロード" (Excel) is in scope and "ダウンロード一覧 / ダウンロード依頼" (invoice PDF batch) is not affected.
In the image the same invoice number (B-20260827-0011) appears in several rows with different Invoice Types. Is this only sample data? We understand 1 invoice number = 1 Billing To = 1 Invoice Type.
T-010 performance: how many records should be used as "large volume", and what response time is acceptable (current level as baseline)?

supporting_docs.text:
Invoice List



By Kenneth Nursalim

25 min

Listen

Add a reaction
Screen

請求書一覧 (Invoice List)

Screen number

INV-060-013

Where to find it

在庫管理 (Inventory Control) → 売上・請求処理 (Sales and Billing Process) → 請求書一覧 (Invoice List)

Owner

L-DX

Status

Draft

Verified against

Backend v0.54.124 (development) + Frontend v0.309.8 (master), local development stack, on 2026-09-02

1. What is this screen?
This screen lists every invoice (請求書) the company has issued — one row per invoice. A row appears the moment a billing (請求) to a billing destination is confirmed, and it shows the invoice's headline figures: what was carried over from the previous invoice, what the customer has paid, this period's sales, and the total being claimed. Staff who issue and check invoices use it to find an issued invoice, check those figures, open the invoice as the customer will see it, export the list to Excel, and request the invoice PDFs that go out to customers.

It is a read-and-download screen. Nothing here creates, edits, confirms or deletes an invoice — those actions belong to 請求情報一覧 Billing Info List and 請求情報登録 Create Billing Detail (see §3.8).

Part of the Order-to-Cash flow — see that page for the end-to-end picture.

Where you are in the flow:

Flow

Position

Order-to-Cash

請求情報登録 Create Billing Detail / 請求情報一覧 Billing Info List ← You are here → 請求書プレビュー Invoice Preview

2. Before you start
Permissions. Internal users at every access level — view-only, editor and approver — see the identical screen with every button active, including [ダウンロード依頼] (Request Download), the one action here that creates something (a PDF request and its files); this is described from the access configuration. Guest access: TBD — confirm at review; until it is settled, treat this screen as one for internal users. Without the menu entry the page shows the access-refused message listed in §4.

Note for reviewers: the neighbouring billing pages state that billing data is closed to guest accounts, while the access configuration read for this page defines no guest-specific narrowing. Whether a guest who holds the menu entry can open this list must be settled with a real guest login — the sentence above will be rewritten either way.

Prerequisites. An invoice exists only after its billing has been confirmed — by hand on Billing Info List or Create Billing Detail, or automatically in the cases listed in the lifecycle chain below. The billings themselves are created in bulk on 売掛金一覧 Account Receivable List or one destination at a time on 請求先・得意先別売掛金一覧 Accounts Receivable List by Billing To and Customer.

The closing-period banner. When an accounting period is closed, the yellow banner "Closing is currently in effect until 2026/05/31 and some editing function is locked." shows at the top of this screen, as on every other screen. It blocks nothing here: invoices dated inside the closed period still list, export and print (what the lock does affect is noted in the lifecycle chain below).

Performance. A search runs over every issued invoice — hundreds of thousands of rows in a mature system — so it can take a moment. Exporting the whole list shows only a spinner on the button — no progress bar — and can take a long time. A PDF request returns at once but the PDFs are produced in the background, one invoice at a time; opening the Download List and picking up a large merged PDF are the heavier steps. Request PDFs in reasonable batches rather than hundreds at a time.

Billing lifecycle at a glance
The invoice has no status column of its own. Its life is the life of the billing behind it, and an invoice row exists on this screen exactly while that billing is confirmed:

billing created (Account Receivable List, or one destination at a time) → 
下書き DRAFT
 — 請求確定 Billing Confirmation on Billing Info List or Create Billing Detail (needs the Approval level); automatic for billings created by Batch Create Billing on Account Receivable List, for prepayment invoices (前払) raised from an advance payment, and for cash-type destinations → 
確定 CONFIRMED — INVOICE ISSUED, ROW APPEARS HERE
 — 削除 Delete the billing on Billing Info List (needs the Edit level), newest billing of that destination only → (row disappears)

A draft billing can also be deleted before it is ever confirmed — it never reaches this list.

There is no un-confirm and no cancel. An issued invoice is corrected by deleting its billing, fixing the source slips and creating the billing again — never on this screen (§3.8).

Billings of one destination form a chain — each invoice starts from the previous one's balance — so only the newest billing of a destination can be deleted; and, as documented on 請求情報一覧 Billing Info List, a billing dated in a closed accounting period cannot be deleted until the period is reopened. Both rules belong to that screen.

A separate payment-confirmation status (入金確定) exists on the billing but is not shown here; see 請求情報登録 Create Billing Detail.

What each state allows on this screen (search, export, PDF request) is tabulated in §5 States and what each allows.

PDF request lifecycle at a glance
Each PDF request made with [ダウンロード依頼] (Request Download) is a second, short-lived document, watched in the [ダウンロード一覧] (Download List) dialog (§3.6). It moves by itself — no button on this screen changes its status:

保留中 PENDING
 — request placed, PDF work not yet started (automatic) → 
進行中 STARTED
 — PDFs produced one invoice at a time (automatic) → 
完了 DONE
 — [ダウンロード] (Download) offered on the row; 進行中 — an error while producing a PDF → 
失敗 FAILED

A request whose invoices already have PDFs is 完了 at once (§3.5).

There is no cancel and no retry on this screen: a request that is no longer wanted simply stays in the list, and a 失敗 (Failed) request is reported to your administrator with its date. A value 取消 (Cancelled) exists in the system's vocabulary, but nothing on this screen produces it.

The status is blank when the request has no invoices behind it.

What each status allows is tabulated in §5 States and what each allows.


Diagram source (Mermaid)
3. Tasks
3.1 Find invoices
When: any time you need to locate an issued invoice — to check its figures, quote its number to a customer, or select rows for an Excel export or a PDF request.

Open the screen from the menu. Three filters are visible — 請求書番号 (Invoice No), 請求先 (Billing To) and 掛売／前払 (Credit Sales/Prepayment) — and the list already shows every invoice, newest first. 

Press [開く] (Expand) to reveal the other six filters. 

Fill any combination — no filter is required:

顧客を表示 (Display 顧客): untick it to hide the walk-in 顧客 account — every consumer sale bundled under one destination, which makes up the vast majority of rows — and see named destinations only. Tick the box again to bring those rows back.

請求書番号 (Invoice No) matches partially: 0038 finds every invoice whose number contains 0038. 

請求先 (Billing To): click the field and type part of the code or the name. The list shows [code] name and includes archived destinations, so old invoices stay findable. 

掛売／前払 (Credit Sales/Prepayment): 掛売 (Credit Sales) for ordinary invoices, 前払 (Prepayment) for invoices raised from an advance payment (§3.2). 

Date ranges: 納品日 (Delivery Date), 請求タイミング (Billing Timing) — which, despite its name, filters the 請求日 (Billing Date) column — and 締め日 (Closing Date). Days inside a closed accounting period stay selectable. 

Amount ranges: 前回ご請求金額 (Previous Billing Amount) and 今回請求書金額 (Current Invoice Amount) each take a Minimum and a Maximum. If the Maximum you type is smaller than the Minimum, it is silently raised to the Minimum when you leave the field. 

Press [検索] (Search). The list reloads on page 1 and the caption "Total N items" updates. There is no Clear button — blank the fields yourself or reload the screen; filters are not remembered between visits. 

Page through with the pager: 10 rows per page by default, selectable up to 500. The page number is kept in the address bar. 


Result: the matching invoices, always newest first — the columns cannot be sorted. Ticks are cleared whenever you page, search or change the page size, so anything you select for an export or a PDF request must sit on one page; raise the page size first if you need more than ten rows.

3.2 Read an invoice row
When: you want the headline figures of an invoice without opening it, or the four amounts on an old row no longer add up.

Find the row (§3.1) and scroll the table to the right for the four amount columns — the row itself is read-only. 


The four amounts are the closing figures of the billing that produced the invoice, defined exactly as on the preview:

前回請求金額 (Previous Billing Amount) — the ご請求金額 of this destination's previous invoice — the amount that invoice asked the customer to pay — carried into this one.

ご入金額 (Deposit Amount) — money received from the customer and recorded in this billing period, whatever it was paying for; refunds count negative.

今回請求書金額 (Current Invoice Amount) — this period's own sales, tax included, less returns and credits.

ご請求金額 (Billing Amount) — the number to tell the customer: 前回請求金額 + 今回請求書金額 − ご入金額.

今回請求書金額 and ご請求金額 are fixed when the billing is confirmed, so the printed claim never changes. 前回請求金額 and ご入金額 are read from the billing each time the list is shown. A deposit recorded after this invoice was issued belongs to the next billing and does not change this row, so in normal operation the four figures always satisfy the identity in §6. The only case in which they stop adding up is a re-valuation of the billing carried out on the system side after issue — a maintenance operation, not a screen action; the printed invoice always carries the fixed pair. Full definitions and worked examples are on Invoice Preview §5 (rows 8, 9, 11 and 12) and Invoice Preview §6; this list derives nothing of its own.

Note for reviewers: Invoice Preview §5 row 12 (and the Result line of its task 3.4) currently say that a deposit arriving after issuance moves the balance shown on screen; this page follows the verified behaviour — deposits are attached to the billing when it is created, so a later deposit belongs to the next billing. One of the two pages must change; please settle which before sign-off.

How the amounts look: whole yen with thousands separators and no currency symbol; a zero prints as 0; a cell is blank only when there is no value at all; negative amounts are red with a leading minus sign. A negative ご請求金額 means the customer is in credit — typically after a return. 

掛売／前払 (Credit Sales/Prepayment) tells you which kind of invoice the row is: 掛売 (Credit Sales) is the ordinary invoice; 前払 (Prepayment) is an invoice raised from a shipment that was set to advance payment. It is not the destination's invoice print type (詳細版, 簡易版 and the other layouts — a Billing To Master (link TBD: Billing To Master) setting that decides what the PDF looks like). Prepayment rows carry no carry-over and no deposit, so their 今回請求書金額 and ご請求金額 are equal. 

Result: you can read the four amounts and tell the pair fixed at confirmation from the pair read from the billing, without opening the invoice.

3.3 Open an invoice to see it as the customer will
When: you need the line items, the tax summary, or the PDF of a single invoice.

Press [詳細] (Detail) — the second column of the row, pinned to the left edge. It is a link, so it can also be opened in a new browser tab.

Result: 請求書プレビュー Invoice Preview opens in issued-invoice mode with [一覧へ戻る] (Back To List), [ダウンロード] (Download) and [更新] (Update); what each does is described on that page. The preview also shows 残高 (Balance), which this list does not. 

3.4 Download the list to Excel
When: you need the invoices in a spreadsheet — offline reconciliation, a report attachment, a check against the customer's own records.

Filter the list first — the export honours the current filters and takes every matching row, not just the page you see.

With nothing ticked the button reads [全件ダウンロード] (Download All) and exports every matching row. Tick rows and it changes to [ダウンロード] (Download), which exports only the ticked rows — they must sit on the current page (§3.1). 

When [全件ダウンロード] (Download All) covers more than 1,000 rows a confirmation asks first: "Downloading all records will affect the whole system's performance. Are you sure to proceed?" — press [確定] (Confirm) to go ahead, or [キャンセル] (Cancel) and narrow the filters. The dialog has no × and does not close when you click outside it. Exports of 1,000 rows or fewer start straight away. 


Wait while the button shows its spinner — the only progress indicator; a large export takes a while (performance note in §2).

Result: an Excel file in your browser's download folder, named {screen name}_YYYYMMDD_hhmm.xlsx with the screen name in your UI language — Invoice List_20260902_0258.xlsx in English, 請求書一覧_… in Japanese. It holds the twelve list columns in screen order with the same values, ordered newest first, and it includes the invoices of archived destinations. Three things differ from the screen: the last header reads 今回ご請求金額 (Current Billing Amount) — the same value as the on-screen ご請求金額; dates are written as text in the form YYYY-MM-DD, on the same calendar day the screen shows; and 掛売／前払 is written as the label of your UI language. Amounts are true numbers — negatives negative, zero as 0.

Exports above the row limit set for your company are refused; the message the system defines for this case is listed in §4 — narrow the filters and try again. These exports are heavy on the system, which is why the limit and the confirmation exist.

3.5 Request the invoice PDFs
When: it is time to send invoices out and you want the PDFs of several invoices produced together.

Tick the invoices you need — the header checkbox ticks the whole page. [ダウンロード依頼] (Request Download) is greyed out until at least one row is ticked. 


Press [ダウンロード依頼] (Request Download). A green message appears: "The file is currently downloading. Please wait a moment for it to complete" (ファイルをダウンロード中です。完了までしばらくお待ちください。). 

Nothing else on the screen changes: the rows stay ticked and no row shows a status. Your request now sits in the Download List — collect it as in §3.6.

Result: one request named 一括請求作成 - YYYY-MM-DD (today's date in Japan time; the name stays in Japanese in the English UI). The PDFs are produced in the background, one invoice at a time — roughly a minute per invoice — with no progress indicator on this screen.

Worth knowing:

A PDF once produced is reused, never regenerated. Requesting an invoice that already has a PDF shows the same green message, and the new request is 完了 (Done) at once. The file shows the figures as they stood when it was first produced; if the billing is corrected afterwards the file is not refreshed, and no action on this screen regenerates it. 

Invoices whose destination is flagged 一括請求書から除外 (Exclude from Batch Invoice) on the Billing To Master (link TBD: Billing To Master) can be ticked and requested, but they are left out of the merged PDF (described from the system definition, not observed). When every invoice in a request belongs to such a destination, the request still reaches 完了 (Done), but pressing its [ダウンロード] (Download) does nothing (§4).

The request is the only thing this screen ever writes. It never touches the invoice or the billing.

3.6 Pick up a requested PDF
When: a few minutes after a request, to collect the merged PDF.

Press [ダウンロード一覧] (Download List). A dialog of the same name lists the requests made from this screen, newest first, with its own pager and, after an unlabelled leading column, four labelled columns: ファイル名 (File Name), ステータス (Status), ユーザーID (User ID — the login of the person who made the request) and アクション (Action). It is refreshed every time you open it. 

Read the status. 進行中 (Started) means the PDFs are still being produced and the Action cell is empty; when it turns 完了 (Done) the row shows [ダウンロード] (Download). To refresh, press [閉じる] (Close) and open the dialog again. Every status value is explained in the request-status table of §5 States and what each allows, and the request's lifecycle is drawn in §2.

Press the row's [ダウンロード] (Download). The merged PDF opens in a new browser tab. If no tab appears, the browser may have blocked it as a pop-up — allow pop-ups for this site and press [ダウンロード] again (every press rebuilds the merged file, so nothing is lost). 

Result: one PDF with the requested invoices, ordered by billing-destination code, named 一括請求作成 YYYY_MM_DD - Combined, All.pdf. The date in that file name follows world standard time (UTC, nine hours behind Japan) rather than Japan time and is taken from the moment the request was made: a request placed between 00:00 and 09:00 (Japan time) yields a file dated the previous day while the Download List row shows today; the contents are unaffected. Each press of [ダウンロード] re-assembles the bundle from the invoices' stored PDFs — the individual invoice PDFs themselves are never regenerated (§3.5).

If a row stays at 進行中 or 保留中 for a long time, the system has not finished — or not started — producing the PDFs: close the dialog, wait, and reopen it; if it never moves, contact your administrator. If a row shows 完了 but [ダウンロード] does nothing, see §4.

3.7 Come back to the list from an invoice
When: you opened an invoice from this list and want to continue searching.

On Invoice Preview press [一覧へ戻る] (Back To List), top left — it appears only when the preview was opened from this list. 

Result: the list reloads without your previous search — every filter is cleared, 顧客を表示 (Display 顧客) is ticked again, and page 1 of the full list is shown. Re-enter your search terms. This is product-wide behaviour, also noted on Invoice Preview §3.5.

3.8 Understand what appears here and where to act on an invoice
When: an invoice you expect is missing, an issued invoice is wrong, or you need to remove one.

Check the billing's status on 請求情報一覧 Billing Info List — the cases below tell you which screen to act on.

Only confirmed billings become invoices. 請求情報一覧 Billing Info List shows every billing from the moment it is created; this list shows it from the moment it is confirmed. A billing you can see there but not here has simply not been confirmed yet.

Some invoices arrive by themselves — the billings that are confirmed automatically are listed in the lifecycle chain in §2.

To correct an issued invoice, delete its billing on Billing Info List — the rules on which billing can be deleted are in §2 — correct the source slips, and create and confirm the billing again. Nothing on this screen deletes, edits or re-numbers an invoice, and the two fixed amounts are never refreshed in place — see Invoice Preview §3.6.

Archived destinations keep their invoices — see the Archival note in §5.

Bulk registration lives on the billing side, not here. Most billings are created together by 一括請求作成 Batch Create Billing on Account Receivable List; a file-import screen, Billing Info Batch Registration (link TBD: Billing Info Batch Registration) (請求情報一括登録), exists without a menu entry and is used for system-led migrations; it will have its own page. Invoices themselves have no batch screen: the closest thing on this list is the PDF request, which acts on many invoices at once.

Result: you know which sibling screen to go to — nothing on this list itself needs to change.

4. Errors & messages

Closing period: no effect on this screen. Invoices dated in a closed period still list, filter, export and print; the three date filters deliberately allow closed days. The one thing the lock blocks — deleting such a billing — is a Billing Info List rule (§2).

Archival: invoices are never archived — they exist until their billing is deleted. The one master this screen draws on, the Billing To Master, can be archived: existing invoices keep showing the archived destination (code with an _archived suffix), the 請求先 (Billing To) filter still offers it, and the export includes it. Registering a new document for an archived destination does not arise here — nothing is registered on this screen; whether a new billing can be raised for an archived destination is a rule of the billing screens (see Terminology for the principle: past data stays visible, new registration is refused).

Timezone: dates are entered and shown as calendar days in Japan time; a one-day range returns exactly that day, and the Excel export writes the same day. One known deviation: the merged PDF's file name follows UTC and is taken from the moment the request was made (§3.6).

Label pairs that name one value: filter 前回ご請求金額 and column 前回請求金額; on-screen ご請求金額 and Excel header 今回ご請求金額. Each is quoted as it appears.

6. How the amounts are calculated
This screen calculates nothing. The four amount columns are the closing figures of the billing behind the invoice; two of them are fixed at confirmation. All rounding happened earlier: each sales slip's line amounts and consumption tax were rounded when the slip was registered, following the company's sales rounding setting (Rounding Method for Sales in the company settings) — the mode in force and the worked examples are in the Sales Slip Registration calculation section. The carry-over arithmetic that assembles an invoice is explained on Invoice Preview §6. Assumption: currency JPY (whole yen); no rounding mode applies on this page — every mode-dependent figure was fixed upstream, and the list shows the stored figures as they are.
